name: Firebase web app apiKey
description: The apiKey of a Firebase web app configuration, an AIza-prefixed Google API key. Firebase documents that API keys restricted to Firebase services only identify the project and app and need not be treated as secrets, while a key used for the Gemini Developer API must never be included in code or configuration files. The two are the same shape, and nothing in the value says which applies. The sibling claim is conditional on the restriction; it does not make every AIza value benign.

sources.supports: API keys restricted to Firebase services 'do not need to be treated as secrets' and may be included in code or configuration files, because they only identify the project and app; authorization is handled by IAM, Security Rules and App Check. The same page says a key used for the Gemini Developer API must never be included in code or configuration files.
